citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 1:30 PM on 16 July
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee/registrant by calling both numbers and rang the doorbell, waited
half an hour and called again. Registrant replied after 2 PM that no one was available today. Failure to provide access to
the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide
access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
